reviews.comment:
Generalmente la atención es buena, en ocasiones te discuten cuánto combustible cargarte; Cuando vos sos el que conoces bien tu vehículo, al menos yo, conozco muy bien el tanque de mi moto.
Y no solo no te escuchan lo que vos le decís, sino, que te hablan mal,  a algunos playeros les molesta que le pagues con la aplicación,  posiblemente porque los demanda a hacer un pequeño trámite.
Gracias

(Translated by Google)
Generally, the service is good, although sometimes they argue with you about how much fuel to put in; even though you're the one who knows your vehicle well—at least I know my motorcycle's tank very well.

And not only do they not listen to what you say, but they speak rudely to you. Some attendants get annoyed when you pay with the app, possibly because it requires them to complete a small transaction.
Thanks
